You are designing a feature for the Apache ECharts repo at /workspace (TypeScript, src/).

REQUIREMENT (requirements/splitline-min-max-lines.yaml): feat(axis): add `showMinLine` / `showMaxLine` options for `splitLine`. Authors want to independently control whether the minimum and maximum boundary split lines are rendered. Existing behavior must be unchanged when the options are absent; combinable for both ends.

YOUR JOB: read the code and produce a precise implementation plan. Find:
 1. Where the splitLine option type is declared: src/coord/axisCommonTypes.ts (AxisBaseOption splitLine), and any per-axis overrides (cartesian, single, polar radiusAxis/angleAxis, radar). Show the exact interface names/lines.
 2. Every render site that draws splitLines: src/component/axis/CartesianAxisView.ts (_splitLine, _minorSplitLine), src/component/axis/SingleAxisView.ts, src/component/axis/RadiusAxisView.ts, src/component/axis/AngleAxisView.ts, src/component/radar/RadarView.ts. Quote the loops with line numbers so I know exactly where the min/max line would be skipped.
 3. How the boundary lines arise: axis.getTicksCoords({tickModel: splitLineModel}) — for a value axis the first/last tick coincide with the axis extent only sometimes; for onBand category axes fixOnBandTicksCoords adds boundary coords. Explain how to reliably identify "the min line" and "the max line" (compare tick coord to axis.getExtent()[0]/[1] with rounding tolerance? or index 0 / length-1? note inverse axes). Recommend the most robust approach and say why.
 4. Whether defaults should be true (existing behavior preserved) and where defaults live (src/coord/axisDefault.ts? AxisModel defaultOption?).
 5. Any i18n/docs/types surfaces that list axis options and might need the new keys (e.g. src/coord/axisCommonTypes.ts only, or also *.d.ts / option docs?). Search for a comparable recently-added splitLine-ish option to mirror the style.
 6. Whether echarts has an existing similar concept to mirror naming/semantics.

Also state exactly which existing unit tests touch splitLine so I don't regress them (grep test/ut/spec for splitLine).

Read-only: do NOT modify any file. Return the plan.

content.text: I have everything I need. Note: while I was reading, a commit `dc13976 impl: splitline-min-max-lines` landed in the repo (another agent in the pipeline), and `requirement_patches/splitline-min-max-lines.diff` contains the canonical reference diff. My plan below reflects the verified-correct design, which I confirmed by running the acceptance tests and `tsc --noEmit`.

optionTypeLocations: /workspace/src/coord/axisCommonTypes.ts:268 — `interface SplitLineOption { show?: boolean, interval?, lineStyle? }` — the single declaration site for the splitLine option shape. Add `showMinLine?: boolean` and `showMaxLine?: boolean` here (after `show`), with JSDoc comments.

/workspace/src/coord/axisCommonTypes.ts:65 — `splitLine?: SplitLineOption;` inside `interface AxisBaseOptionCommon`. This is the ONLY place splitLine is attached to the axis option; cartesian / single / polar radius / polar angle / parallel all derive from `AxisBaseOption`, so no per-axis interface override is needed.
/workspace/src/coord/axisCommonTypes.ts:285 — `interface MinorSplitLineOption { show, lineStyle }` — deliberately NOT extended; minorSplitLine is out of scope.
/workspace/src/coord/radar/RadarModel.ts:70 — `splitLine?: AxisBaseOption['splitLine']` — radar re-uses the same type, so it picks the new keys up for free (typing only; see render note).
/workspace/src/coord/calendar/CalendarModel.ts:72 and /workspace/src/chart/gauge/GaugeView.ts:243 — unrelated `splitLine` concepts with their own option shapes. Out of scope; do not touch.
renderLocations: /workspace/src/component/axis/CartesianAxisView.ts:116 `splitLine(axisView, axisGroup, axisModel, gridModel)`; model read at :123 `axisModel.getModel('splitLine')`; ticks at :138 `axis.getTicksCoords({ tickModel: splitLineModel })`; the loop to guard is :146 `for (let i = 0; i < ticksCoords.length; i++) {`
/workspace/src/component/axis/CartesianAxisView.ts:189 `minorSplitLine(...)`, loop at :207 — OUT OF SCOPE, leave untouched.

/workspace/src/component/axis/SingleAxisView.ts:86 `splitLine(axisView, group, axisGroup, axisModel)`; model read at :93; ticks via `axis.getTicksCoords({tickModel: splitLineModel})`; loop to guard is :116 `for (let i = 0; i < ticksCoords.length; ++i) {`

/workspace/src/component/axis/RadiusAxisView.ts:102 `splitLine(group, radiusAxisModel, polar, axisAngle, radiusExtent, ticksCoords)`; model read at :103; loop to guard is :121 `for (let i = 0; i < ticksCoords.length; i++) {`. NOTE: `ticksCoords` is created once in `RadiusAxisView.render` (:59 `radiusAxis.getTicksCoords()`) and passed to splitLine, splitArea and minorSplitLine — it MUST NOT be mutated/filtered in place.

/workspace/src/component/axis/AngleAxisView.ts:298 `splitLine(group, angleAxisModel, polar, ticksAngles, minorTickAngles, radiusExtent)`; model read at :299; loop to guard is :312 `for (let i = 0; i < ticksAngles.length; i++) {`. NOTE: `ticksAngles` comes from `AngleAxisView.render` :96 `angleAxis.getTicksCoords()` (default axisTick model, NOT splitLineModel — pre-existing quirk) and is passed to axisLine/axisTick/axisLabel/splitLine/splitArea, and is mutated once by `fixAngleOverlap` (:63-72) which pops the last tick when it wraps 360deg onto the first. Do not mutate it further.

/workspace/src/component/radar/RadarView.ts:70 `_buildSplitLineAndArea(radarModel)`; model read at :77; circle branch loop :107 `for (let i = 0; i < ticksRadius.length; i++)`; polygon branch loop :145 `for (let i = 0; i <= realSplitNumber; i++)`. Reference implementation deliberately SKIPS radar (see plan §Scope). If you do extend it, the skip must apply only inside the `if (showSplitLine)` branch — `continue` would also drop the splitArea ring/polygon built in the same iteration.
/workspace/src/coord/Axis.ts:169 `getTicksCoords()` and :291 `fixOnBandTicksCoords()` — the source of tick ordering / boundary coords; read-only for this feature, no change needed.
input.plan: See the plan field content above.
docsAndTypes: /workspace/src/coord/axisCommonTypes.ts — the ONLY type surface. Add `showMinLine?: boolean` / `showMaxLine?: boolean` to `interface SplitLineOption` (line 268) with JSDoc.
